title: Siri Paye
attribution: Recipe adapted from Food Fusion (foodfusion.com). Not an official Food Fusion product.

items.raw: Adrak lehsan paste (Ginger garlic paste) 3 tbs

items.item: Kashmiri lal mirch (Kashmiri red chili) powder
items.raw: Kashmiri lal mirch (Kashmiri red chili) powder 1 tsp
Adrak lehsan paste (Ginger garlic paste) 2 tbs
Namak (Salt) ½ tsp or to taste
Lal mirch powder (Red chili powder) 1 tsp or to taste

items.item: Kashmiri lal mirch (Kashmiri red chili) powder
items.raw: Kashmiri lal mirch (Kashmiri red chili) powder 1 tsp

steps.instruction: In pot,add cooking oil,mutton mix boti and mix well until changes color and fry for 4-5 minutes then take out in a bowl.
steps.romanUrdu: Pot mein cooking oil aur mutton mix boti dal dein aur rang tabdeel hunay tak ache tarhan mix karein aur 4-5 minutes kliya fry ker lein phir bowl mein nikla lein.

steps.instruction: Add bay leaves,black cardamom,cinnamon sticks,cloves,black peppercorns,cumin seeds and mix well.
steps.romanUrdu: Tez paat,badi elaichi,darchini,laung,sabut kali mirch aur zeera dal ker ache tarhan mix ker lein.

steps.instruction: Add onion and fry until light brown.
steps.romanUrdu: Pyaz dal dein aur light brown hunay tak fry ker lein.

steps.instruction: Add mutton trotters and mix well until changes color.
steps.romanUrdu: Mutton paya dal dein aur rang tabdeel hunay tak ache tarhan mix ker lein.

steps.instruction: Add mutton head and fry for 4-5 minutes.
steps.romanUrdu: Siri shamil karein aur 4-5 minutes kliya fry ker lein.

steps.instruction: Add ginger garlic paste,salt,coriander powder,red chili crushed,kashmiri red chili powder and mix well for 4-5 minutes.
steps.romanUrdu: Adrak lehsan paste,namak,dhania powder,lal mirch crushed aur kashmiri lal mirch powder dal ker 4-5 minutes kliya ache tarhan mix ker lein.

steps.instruction: Add water and mix well,cover and cook on low flame for 1 hour.
steps.romanUrdu: Pani dal ker mix karein aur dhak ker halki ancch per 1 hour kliya paka lein.

steps.instruction: Add fried mutton mix boti and mix well,cover and cook on low flame until meat is tender (approx. 1 hour) then cook on high flame until water is reduced.
steps.romanUrdu: Fried mutton mix boti dal ker ache tarhan mix karein aur dhak ker halki anchh per ghost gul janay tak paka lein (approx. 1 hour) phir tez ancch per pani reduce ho janay tak paka lein.

steps.instruction: In wok,add cooking oil,bay leaves,cumin seeds and mix well.
steps.romanUrdu: Karhai mein cooking oil,tez paat aur zeera dal ker ache tarhan mix ker lein.

steps.instruction: Add black cardamom,cloves,cinnamon sticks and mix well.
steps.romanUrdu: Badi elaichi,laung aur darchini dal ker mix karein.

steps.instruction: Add ginger garlic paste and mix well.
steps.romanUrdu: Adrak lehsan paste dal ker ache tarhan mix ker lein.

steps.instruction: Add onion and fry until translucent.
steps.romanUrdu: Pyaz dal ker translucent hunay tak fry ker lein.

steps.instruction: Add yogurt and mix well.
steps.romanUrdu: Dahi dal ker ache tarhan mix karein.

steps.instruction: Add salt,red chili powder,kashmiri red chili powder and mix well.
steps.romanUrdu: Namak,lal mirch powder aur kashmiri lal mirch powder dal ker ache tarhan mix karein.

steps.instruction: Add turmeric powder,mix well and cook until oil separates (8-10 minutes).
steps.romanUrdu: Haldee powder dal ker ache tarhan mix karein aur oil alag hunay tak paka lein (8-10 minutes).

steps.instruction: Now add yogurt mixture into cooked siri paye mixture,mix well and cook for 8-10 minutes.
steps.romanUrdu: Ab cooked siri paya ka mixture mein dahi wala mixture dal ker ache tarhan mix karein aur 8-10 minutes kliya paka lein.

steps.instruction: Add garam masala powder and mix well.
steps.romanUrdu: Garam masala powder dal ker ache tarhan mix ker lein.

steps.instruction: Add water,mix well and cook until desired consistency.
steps.romanUrdu: Pani shamil karein aur ache tarhan mix ker ka desired consistency anay tak paka lein.

steps.instruction: Remove & discard bay leaves and black cardamoms.
steps.romanUrdu: Tez paat aur badi elaichi nikla lein.

steps.instruction: Garnish with ginger,green chilies,fresh coriander & serve.
steps.romanUrdu: Adrak,hari mirch aur hara dhania sa garnish ker ka serve karein.

ogDescription: Another must try Eid Recipe for you. Make Siri Paye this Eid and Enjoy. #HappyCookingToyou
